rationale: The agent properly authenticated the user using full name plus corrected ZIP code and then accessed the user’s orders. However, in the final response the agent stated that the order was paid "using your Mastercard ending in 1065" without any tool output confirming the payment method for that specific order—only the stored payment method on the account was shown. This is an unsupported assertion and violates the policy against inventing details. Additionally, while the amount quoted ($829.43) matches the visible sum of item prices, the transcript doesn’t show an order total, taxes, or shipping; the agent’s phrasing "You paid $829.43" may conflate item subtotal with total paid if such charges exist. Because the response includes at least one unsupported claim, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
